findings.title: Call to non-existent zero-argument isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() breaks compilation
findings.body: The condition calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments. The only definition added in this PR is `protected boolean isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)` in UsernamePasswordForm, and no zero-argument overload exists in the diff or in the file. The services module will fail to compile, so none of the passkey re-authentication fixes can ship. The intended call is likely `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser())`.

findings.body: The diff removed the only uses of `NoSuchElementException` in this file (the `Assert.assertThrows(NoSuchElementException.class, ...)` calls in passwordLoginWithNonDiscoverableKey). The import on line 51 is now unused, which will produce a compiler/checkstyle warning.
